bestBets.overview: Wodonga was rated Heavy 9 on Saturday afternoon but the forecast looks lovely in the early part of the week so we should make some improvement in terms of conditions. We start raceday on Heavy 8 but I'm backing an upgrade as we get into the day. We rev up with a 1400m Maiden. BRILLIANT BULLANT does not help himself at all by missing the start so often but he really does look on the verge of a breakthrough after a succession of solid finishes on both turf and synthetic. Two newcomers - PRESTIGE ISAAC won his latest jumpout on Heavy 10 at Cranbourne; led throughout and was ridden along to do it. FULL POTENTIAL has come in at or near last in six jumpouts since late 2025.

raceTips.comment: Brilliant Bull Ant has a poor habit of being slowly away but clearly brings in the best form and has found a very winnable race here. Star Royal should get favours on speed. Masakari should be strong late and will take fitness improvement from a sound first up run.

bestBets.overview: Essentially a race to learn from; I can't muster a lot of confidence about this one. Back to ten runners after scratchings. IRONIC FORTUNE can jump on-speed and could be hard to get past 2nd-up. WOOSH was posted wide without cover on resumption and while she draws deep again she is fitter and has found a very winnable race right here. MILLIONAIRE LOVER sets up nicely on-speed and wasn't beaten far down south. BRIAR ISLAND has had six jumpouts overall, three recently. Looms as one that might need time. CULTURAL INTEREST has won two out of three and stablemate MOJO JUNIOR won his latest as well but both runners had no rider booked on Sunday morning so something will need to fall into place in that regard.

raceTips.comment: Millionaire Lover brings in the strongest form for this event and looks very well placed making the trip up the highway for this event. Woosh didn't fire fresh but was okay in Stakes grade in Tasmania prior. Ironic Fortunes best would have him in the finish here.
